description: This Java source file defines an Android activity named MultiRes that displays a series of photos with navigation controls. It manages state across configuration changes and updates the UI accordingly.

classes.name: MultiRes
classes.description: An Android Activity that displays a photo gallery with next button navigation, handling state preservation across configuration changes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, displays the first photo, and sets the click listener for the 'Next' button.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current photo index to the instance state bundle.

methods.name: onRestoreInstanceState
methods.description: Restores the photo index from saved state and updates the display accordingly.

methods.name: showPhoto
methods.description: Updates the ImageView and status TextView to show the photo at the specified index.
